1.why: I am a biology and philosophy student, so I find math interesting but not my strength. I feel average about it.

2.why: I have low extraversion and agreeableness. Math class feels intimidating to me personally.

3.why: As an upper secondary student, I think I can learn the concepts, but sometimes struggle with abstract ideas.

4.why: My future career in biology requires some math, so I expect to manage it reasonably well without too much stress.

5.why: Chemistry is a subject I dislike and math seems similar. Understanding complex formulas feels challenging for me.

6.why: I am not confident about getting top grades in math because my parents have lower education levels.

7.why: The coursework should be manageable, but I feel pressure to perform well under time constraints.

8.why: Tests make me very anxious. My low extraversion makes public evaluation stressful for me.

9.why: I prepare for tests carefully, but still feel some tension before the exam itself.

10.why: Taking math tests triggers high anxiety in me because I fear making mistakes publicly.

11.why: An A seems very difficult to achieve given my struggles with abstract mathematical concepts.

12.why: Getting good grades in math is not easy for me due to my dislike of chemistry-related subjects.

13.why: I feel nervous during tests and doubt my ability to perform well under pressure situations.

14.why: I think I can do okay on tests if I study enough, but I am not fully confident.

15.why: Homework assignments cause me stress because I dislike chemistry and struggle with quantitative subjects.

16.why: Using math outside school feels uncertain to me because it is different from structured class work.

17.why: I am not confident using math in real life because my favorite subjects are biology and philosophy.

18.why: Future career math requirements worry me because I dislike chemistry and struggle with quantitative reasoning.

19.why: Understanding complex mathematics sometimes feels difficult, but I try to keep an open mind.

20.why: Learning math well is possible for me, though it requires extra effort compared to other subjects.

21.why: Listening to instructors feels stressful because I have low extraversion and get nervous in class.

22.why: I worry that my future career will not require much advanced math since I prefer biology.

23.why: I am concerned about my knowledge gaps but feel motivated to improve with practice.

24.why: Giving incorrect answers in class terrifies me because of my introverted personality and low agreeableness.

25.why: I actually feel confident enough to ask questions when I understand something in class.

27.why: Completing assignments is manageable though sometimes challenging for chemistry-related topics.
